snapshot.scope: github-runner/** (19 untracked files) plus root README.md diff vs HEAD

findings.issue: Trusted-ref gate uses GitHub expression `github.ref == vars.TRUSTED_RUNNER_REF`, which compares strings case-insensitively; a push to a case-variant branch (e.g. refs/heads/MAIN) not covered by branch protection is treated as the trusted ref and routed to the persistent self-hosted host.
findings.scenario: Write collaborator without push rights to the protected trusted ref creates and pushes refs/heads/MAIN; TRUSTED_EVENT evaluates true, the trusted selector returns the self-hosted label set, and the checks job executes the attacker's commit as the runtime account on the persistent host. RUNNER_READ_TOKEN is also exposed to the select job on that push (consumed only by trusted selector code).
findings.recommended_direction: Export GITHUB_REF and TRUSTED_RUNNER_REF to the route step and perform byte-exact equality inside scripts/select_runner.py (fallback hosted on mismatch), keep the YAML gate as defence in depth, add a case-variant regression test, and document in references/ci.md that protection rulesets must cover case variants of the trusted ref.
findings.acceptance_check: In a mktemp copy with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1: GITHUB_OUTPUT=/dev/null HOSTED_RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04 TRUSTED_EVENT=true GITHUB_REF=refs/heads/MAIN TRUSTED_RUNNER_REF=refs/heads/main GITHUB_REPOSITORY=acme/widget RUNNER_READ_TOKEN=x PREFERRED_RUNNER_NAME=w PREFERRED_RUNNER_LABEL=repo-ci RUNNER_LABELS='["Linux","X64"]' python3 scripts/select_runner.py must print runner="ubuntu-24.04" before any API request; today the selector ignores GITHUB_REF and would return the self-hosted label array with a stubbed API. A new subtest in tests/test_select_runner.py with GITHUB_REF='refs/heads/MAIN' must pass.

findings.issue: Linux service guidance instructs the administrator to run `sudo ./svc.sh install|start|status` from the runner directory owned by the CI runtime account, executing runtime-writable shell code (svc.sh, .service, bin/*.template) as root; the macOS branch correctly forbids this and uses launchctl only.
findings.scenario: Any code that has executed as the runtime account (every trusted-ref CI job, or the S1 bypass) rewrites svc.sh or .service; the next administrator invocation of `sudo ./svc.sh status|stop|uninstall` runs it as root, escalating from the CI account to root on the host.
findings.recommended_direction: Run svc.sh install once, before any job has executed, from an administrator-owned verified copy (or render the systemd unit directly as the macOS renderer does); afterwards manage the unit only with `systemctl <verb> <exact-unit>` and state that `sudo ./svc.sh` must never be re-run on a runner that has executed jobs.

findings.issue: actions/checkout is referenced by the mutable tag v6 in both the PAT-bearing selector job and the self-hosted checks job; verified 2026-10-08 that refs/tags/v6 currently resolves to d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 (same as v6.1.0).
findings.scenario: A moved or compromised v6 tag changes the code that runs in the token-bearing selector job and on the persistent host without any repository change.
findings.recommended_direction: Pin both `uses:` lines to the full commit SHA with a version comment (e.g. `actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0`) and rely on Dependabot/Renovate for bumps, or document the deliberate choice in the template comment.
